principles: No live CVAT snapshot or locator is needed to code or to run this checklist (DEC-020).
Internal immutable snapshot/revision/hash/provenance, verify and final guards stay unchanged.
No new import adapter or format is created without an approved contract. Items marked PO_DECISION are not decided here.

LabelX never writes annotations to CVAT; fixes happen manually in CVAT and are read back.
Nobody except the PO marks the real-data check PASS.

criticalGap.finding: The code has two ways to create a locked snapshot: live CVAT read (create_snapshot_from_cvat via the read-only adapter) and the internal create_locked_snapshot(JobExport[]). There is NO loader that turns an exported CVAT file into JobExport objects, and no API/command that accepts one.
criticalGap.consequence: PO's exported data cannot be fed into the pipeline today. Building such a loader is a new import format/adapter, which DEC-020 forbids without contract.
criticalGap.decisionNeeded: PO_DECISION: approve (a) an import contract (file format, who owns it, where it lives) or (b) a different way to test with the export, e.g. a one-off PO-run script that builds JobExport from the export and calls create_locked_snapshot, kept out of the product code. Until decided, R11 AC2/AC3 for real data stays BLOCKED and the E2E gate is NOT VERIFIED.

loadProcedureOnceFormatIsApproved: 1. Verify sha256 of each received export file against the manifest; stop on mismatch.
2. Build JobExport per job from the export with a read-only loader (no CVAT write); reject missing frames, bad dimensions, non-image bytes.
3. Call create_locked_snapshot with provenance recording file names and checksums; assert status locked, revision_sha256 non-empty, per-job sha256 stable on a second load (idempotent).
4. Create the QC run through the normal API (POST /api/runs/), let the worker finish; record run id, scope_hash, config version, ledger counts.
5. Reviewer claims via the real queue, decides, requests rework (deep link from the CVAT job/frame).
6. PO fixes the annotation manually in CVAT and delivers export 2 (IN-7); annotator submits the new revision via the API; recheck snapshot is built from that export.
7. A different person verifies; test both pass and fail then second fix paths.

8. After all reworks are resolved, the final full-scope snapshot is built from the export covering the whole scope; final run completes; read GET /api/runs/{id}/ for verification_lineage, selected_final_sources, operational_source.

passCriteria.criterion: Snapshot locked; per-job and snapshot hashes reproducible from the same input; media hashes match bytes; provenance lists every input file with checksum
Rework with an unchanged revision is rejected 409 REVISION_UNCHANGED; changed revision creates a recheck snapshot and run
Verify by the annotator or the same natural person is rejected 403; verify before recheck Completed is rejected 409
Verify fail returns the rework to fix_pending, history keeps both rounds append-only; second round can pass
Frame stays awaiting_followup after a verify pass until every issue on the frame is closed and the final run is Completed with full required ledger and no unreviewed new candidate; then it completes

Final snapshot jobs contain the verified revision hash of each reworked job; operational_source selects the final only when scope_complete is true, otherwise blocked_reasons explains why; origin run is unchanged
Read endpoints (rework list/detail, run detail) respect role and dataset scope; no CVAT write call is made at any step
Idle gaps in effort events are excluded per policy 900/300/120 with the deployed config and the stored active_ms matches the recorded timeline
The report records BE SHA, FE SHA, integrated tree, config version and data hashes. Only the PO marks the real-data result PASS; fixture runs are labelled fixture and give no real-data PASS
